# InvokeAI MCP - full LLM reference

## Overview

invokeai-mcp bridges AI coding agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, opencode) and
the fleet webapp to a locally running **InvokeAI** creative engine. InvokeAI
is the open-source professional Stable Diffusion/Flux toolkit (Apache-2.0)
running on the user's GPU, served at http://127.0.0.1:9090 by default.

The server provides:
- Generation: txt2img, img2img, masked inpaint, RealESRGAN upscale
- Queue: status, listing, item results, cancel, clear, pause/resume
- Models: list, install (HuggingFace/Civitai/local), update, delete, stats
- Gallery: search, download, delete, star/unstar, metadata
- Boards: CRUD and image assignment
- Workflows: library CRUD
- Prefab UI cards for dashboard/queue/models/gallery in chat
- A SOTA dark webapp (React/Vite/Tailwind/Zustand) on ports 11154/11155

## Ports

| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 11154 | invokeai-mcp backend (REST /api/*, MCP /mcp) |
| 11155 | webapp frontend (Vite dev) |
| 9090 | InvokeAI engine (owned by InvokeAI) |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| INVOKEAI_URL | http://127.0.0.1:9090 | InvokeAI base URL |
| INVOKEAI_QUEUE_ID | default | Queue id |
| INVOKEAI_DOWNLOAD_DIR | <repo>/data/downloads | Local download dir |
| INVOKEAI_MCP_PORT | 11154 | Backend port |
| INVOKEAI_FRONTEND_PORT | 11155 | Frontend port |
| INVOKEAI_ACCESS_TOKEN | - | Token for gated model sources |
| INVOKEAI_TIMEOUT | 120 | HTTP timeout seconds |

## Tool reference

### invokeai_generate(operation, prompt, ...)

Operations:
- txt2img: prompt -> fresh image (params: model_key, negative_prompt, width,
  height, steps, cfg_scale, scheduler, seed, runs)
- img2img: prompt + image_name (strength 0-1, default 0.75)
- inpaint: prompt + image_name + mask_image_name (white = regenerate)
- upscale: image_name (RealESRGAN 4x)

Model base auto-selects graph family (sd-1, sdxl, flux). Returns
queue_item_id; poll via invokeai_queue result.

Advanced module params (sd-1/sdxl only): seamless_x/seamless_y (tileable
textures), control_image_name + control_model (type=controlnet) +
control_weight + canny_low/canny_high (canny-edge ControlNet), ip_image_name
+ ip_model (type=ip_adapter) + ip_weight (IP-Adapter style transfer).
Image-based modes (img2img/inpaint/outpaint) size the noise to the source
image automatically.

All image-based modes accept image names from the gallery or freshly
uploaded files (POST /api/invokeai/upload, multipart field 'file'). The
webapp renders engine images through the same-origin proxy
GET /api/invokeai/image/{name}.

Example:
```python
invokeai_generate(operation="txt2img", prompt="neon cyberpunk city at night, rain")
invokeai_generate(operation="img2img", prompt="watercolor style", image_name="abc123.png", strength=0.6)
```

### invokeai_queue(operation, ...)

status | list (limit, status_filter) | item_status (item_id) |
result (item_id, wait_seconds, download_image) | cancel (item_id) |
cancel_batch (batch_ids) | clear | resume | pause

result polls to completion and returns output image URLs; with
download_image=True saves the first output locally.

### invokeai_models(operation, ...)

list (model_type, search, limit) | get (key) | install (source, config) |
installs | update (key, config) | delete (key) | stats

install source: HuggingFace repo id, Civitai URL, or local path.

### invokeai_gallery(operation, ...)

list (board_id, starred, limit, offset) | search (query) | get (image_name) |
metadata (image_name) | download (image_name) | delete (image_name) |
star/unstar (image_name)

### invokeai_boards(operation, ...)

list | get (board_id) | create (board_name) | update (board_id, board_name) |
delete (board_id) | add_image/remove_image (board_id, image_names)

### invokeai_workflows(operation, ...)

list | get (workflow_id) | save (workflow_json) | delete (workflow_id)

### invokeai_system(operation, ...)

health | version | config | stats

health returns `configured` (true when InvokeAI reachable) - drives webapp
onboarding state.

### Prefab cards

show_invokeai_dashboard_card | show_invokeai_queue_card |
show_invokeai_models_card | show_invokeai_gallery_card

### invokeai_help(topic) / invokeai_shutdown()

## Webapp REST surface (invokeai-mcp backend, port 11154)

- GET  /api/health - engine reachability + configured flag (onboarding gate)
- GET  /api/dashboard - version, model count, queue counts, recent images
- GET  /api/skills, /api/skills/{name} - SKILL.md content
- GET  /api/tools - dynamic MCP tool list
- GET  /api/logs - ring-buffer logs
- GET  /api/llm/discover, POST /api/llm/chat - local LLM probe + chat proxy
- GET  /api/invokeai/models - main model list (Generate/Models pages)
- GET  /api/invokeai/gallery|boards|workflows - list payloads
- POST /api/invokeai/generate, /api/invokeai/queue - tool passthroughs
- POST /api/invokeai/upload - multipart image upload to the engine
- GET  /api/invokeai/image/{name} - same-origin image proxy (canvas-safe)
- GET  /api/invokeai/plugins - node packs + built-in capability catalog
      (19 categories / 253 nodes, derived live from the engine OpenAPI)
- POST /api/invokeai/plugins/install|reload, DELETE /api/invokeai/plugins/{name}

## Engine-side tuning (invokeai.yaml, install root)

With desktop apps resident on the GPU, cap the engine's VRAM cache and keep
fp16 weights (the fp32 VAE *decode* in the graph fixes black output):

    max_cache_vram_gb: 8
    precision: float16

## Architecture

FastMCP 3.4.4+ with dual transport:
- stdio: `uv run python -m invokeai_mcp.server`
- HTTP: `INVOKEAI_MCP_PORT=11154 uv run python -m invokeai_mcp.server --mode http`
  (MCP at /mcp, REST at /api/*)

Starlette outer app with fleet CORS (localhost, Tauri origins, Tailscale/LAN
regex). Graph builders verified against invoke-ai/InvokeAI main (2026-08):
SD1.5 (main_model_loader + compel), SDXL (sdxl_model_loader +
sdxl_compel_prompt, clip+clip2), FLUX (flux_model_loader + flux_text_encoder
+ flux_denoise + flux_vae_decode). img2img adds image_to_latents with
denoising_start = 1 - strength; inpaint adds create_denoise_mask into
denoise.mask; upscale uses the esrgan node.

## Onboarding

InvokeAI must be installed (launcher), running, and have at least one main
model. The webapp shows declared MOCK content until health succeeds. Full
steps: docs/ONBOARDING.md.

## Troubleshooting

- configured: false -> start InvokeAI (launcher)
- "No main models installed" -> install a model in InvokeAI UI
- CUDA out of memory -> SDXL/SD1.5 or lower resolution
- Queue stuck -> invokeai_queue resume
- outpaint not available -> InvokeAI canvas UI (explicit non-goal)

## Test

- pytest: client (respx mocks), graphs (structure invariants), tools (fake client)
- Playwright e2e: backend health + frontend load
- Gate: `just ci` (ruff + pytest + tsc + biome)

## v0.1.7 additions

Gallery REST feed GET /api/invokeai/gallery supports query/sort
(created_at|name|starred)/order/starred/board/style (catalog style ids,
matched against embedded prompt metadata)/limit/offset. Batch routes:
POST /api/invokeai/gallery/batch {operation: delete|star|unstar,
image_names}, POST /api/invokeai/gallery/board (+DELETE) for board
assignment, POST /api/invokeai/gallery/zip -> zip archive, and
GET /api/invokeai/boards. invokeai_gallery gained batch ops
(batch_delete/batch_star/batch_unstar/board_add/board_remove) with the
image_names parameter. The gallery webapp page has select mode + batch bar.

## v0.1.6 additions

Styles are backend-owned (data/styles.json, 69 presets): invokeai_styles
(operation=list|get|search, style_id/query/limit) lists presets with
id/name/prompt/negative/cfg/steps. Pass ids to
invokeai_generate(styles=["photorealistic","watercolor"], style_cfg=true)
for a multi-style batch - one item per style, style prompt appended,
style cfg/steps applied unless style_cfg=false. REST: GET /api/invokeai/styles.

## v0.1.5 additions

Model families: sd-1, sdxl, flux, cogview4 (CogView4-6B, Apache-2.0, no HF
token - GLM text encoder + transformer denoise nodes). sd-3, qwen-image,
z-image, flux2 builders are follow-up work; the engine supports them natively.

Engine control (webapp Settings > Engine control, REST):
- GET  /api/invokeai/engine/status - running/pid/version
- POST /api/invokeai/engine/start - spawn detached (logs D:\InvokeAI\engine.log)
- POST /api/invokeai/engine/stop

HuggingFace login (gated repos, e.g. official FLUX.1):
- GET  /api/invokeai/hf/status - valid | invalid | unknown
- POST /api/invokeai/hf/login  {token: hf_...}
- DELETE /api/invokeai/hf/logout
Token is stored by the engine (HF cache). UI: Settings > HuggingFace and the
Models page HuggingFace tab. Accept gated licenses once on huggingface.co.

Models directory: N:\InvokeAI-models (engine models_dir in invokeai.yaml).

Model catalog (2026): FLUX.1 dev/schnell + FLUX.2 (gated), SD 3.5 large/medium
(license+token), SDXL/Juggernaut (open, default), CogView4-6B (Apache-2.0),
Z-Image turbo/base (permissive), Qwen-Image 20B (Apache-2.0, needs ~20 GB
fp8 - heavy for a 24 GB GPU with desktop apps), SD 1.5 (legacy).
